text:
maria_cs: FYI Escalation from AcmeCorp — production payments failing intermittently, schema validation errors + big token spike. Customer seeing failed charges and increased invoice amounts. Short thread: 

customer_acme: Hey team — since yesterday ~15:00 UTC some orders fail at the final charge step. We see 400 from your gateway: \"tool_schema_validation_failed: amount must be numeric\". Also noticed their token usage jumped unexpectedly. We didn't change our payloads. Can you advise? :worried:

logan_support: Thanks, can you paste a failing request/response?

customer_acme: Pasting a sanitized example: 
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-rt-1.0",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are a payments assistant. Examples: Charge $200 => call charge_tool with {\"amount\":200}."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Charge customer order #8473 for two hundred dollars"}
  ],
  "functions": [
    {"name":"charge_tool","parameters": {"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"},"currency":{"type":"string"}}}}
  ],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```

customer_acme: Response from generation endpoint (abbreviated): 
```
{
  "id":"g-abc",
  "choices":[{
    "message":{
      "role":"assistant",
      "content": null,
      "function_call": {
        "name":"charge_tool",
        "arguments":"{\"amount\":\"two hundred dollars\", \"currency\":\"USD\"}"
      }
    }
  }],
  "error": null
}
```

customer_acme: Then our charge webhook returns 400 because schema expects number. Billing note: tokens for that request jumped ~+400 tokens compared to previous similar calls (probably from extra few-shot/system text).

maria_cs: That matches other customer reports about fewshot/system examples causing humanized args. Looks like model chooses charge_tool but formats args in words.

james_engr: Preliminary triage: this is prompt/tool instruction conflict -> system prompt few-shot contains humanized examples which leak into assistant output. With `function_call: auto` model chooses function but doesn't normalize types. Short-term fixes: 1) sanitize function args server-side (coerce numeric strings), 2) change route to `function_call: none` + do extraction ourselves, or 3) remove humanized examples from system prompt for this customer.

logan_support: Do we have a repro script we can run locally? customer says it's reproducible.

customer_acme: We can repro every time using the example above. If user input uses words instead of digits it returns string amount.

james_engr: Repro script I ran locally (simplified): 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{\n "model":"redwood-rt-1.0",\n "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a payments assistant. Examples: Charge $200 => call charge_tool with {\"amount\":200}."},{"role":"user","content":"Charge order for two hundred dollars"}],\n "functions":[{"name":"charge_tool","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"},"currency":{"type":"string"}}}}],\n "function_call":"auto"\n}'
```

james_engr: Response shows `arguments` amount as string. I also toggled `function_call: \"none\"` and then ran our local parser; model returned plain text "charge two hundred" which we can post-process more deterministically.

raj_infra: Noted. Two angles: model behavior (LLM side) and platform enforcement. We should not rely on models to type-cast. I'll open a short-term proxy sanitizer that enforces JSON schema on outgoing function calls. If the `amount` is string and matches /\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?/ or word-number, coerce to number; otherwise block and return 400 to client with helpful hint.

sophie_prod: Also saw token spike in logs — looks like system prompt examples are long and repeated per request for some clients. That increases cost. We can dedupe system examples per customer session and reduce latency/cost.

maria_cs: Customer asks for mitigation now. Propose: 1) Enable proxy sanitizer for AcmeCorp (short-term), 2) rollback humanized examples from their system prompt (medium), 3) engineering fix to platform (long — validation + canonicalizers + sampling bias toward numeric tokens for numeric parameters).

james_engr: Agree. I'll PR sanitizer to match schema on function_call arguments and coerce numeric-like strings. Also add a feature flag to force `function_call: none` replacement for risky routes.

deploybot: Canary deploy of sanitizer PR scheduled to staging at 2024-11-08T18:20:00Z — build #5287. :rocket:

logan_support: @customer_acme I'll apply the system prompt edit to remove the few-shot humanized examples while we test sanitizer. That should reduce token use and frequency of malformed args. Can you confirm a maintenance window?

customer_acme: We can accept a short change window now. Please let us know when done so we can test.

james_engr: Action items: [internal] create sanitizer PR (JAMES-453), add unit tests for numeric coercion, add integration test that ensures function argument types match JSON schema. [customer-facing] remove few-shot humanized examples from system prompt for Acme (LOGAN). I'll follow up here when the patch is canaried.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. tagging for visibility: @raj_infra @sophie_prod @james_engr. Will update Acme after canary. :thumbsup:

customer_acme: Thanks — appreciate the quick response. We'll run a few orders once you confirm. :pray:
